output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

commands_run: cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --lib records_loop 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --lib records_loop 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --lib records_ 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --lib records_loop_real 2>&1
cargo test -p xtask --test policy -q 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors -q 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: git status --short | head; ls; wc -l crates/athena-core/src/run/*.rs crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs; ls docs | head -30; date
cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 | grep -v "^ *Compiling\|^ *Checking" | head -60
cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings -A clippy::all 2>&1 | tail -5; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -40
